title: SAE Feature Drift Invalidates Production Control Monitors After Fine-Tuning

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Directly relevant to production safety: if fine-tuning silently invalidates SAE monitors, safety assurances erode without detection. Clear actionable implication for continuous deployment pipelines.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training an SAE on a small base model, fine-tuning the model, and measuring cosine similarity of features is well within medium compute constraints. Each step uses existing tooling (SAE libraries, HuggingFace fine-tuning). Beginners can follow the procedure.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tight deliverable: cosine similarity table of feature dictionary before and after fine-tuning, with breakdown by safety-relevant vs. general features. Clear metrics, single experiment, well-defined output.
